headline_hook: Sonnet 5 Drops With a Science Lab While Claude Code's Hidden Markers Spark a Trust Debate

pick_of_the_day.thesis: The steganographic markers reveal a growing tension between product telemetry and developer trust — and how AI tooling companies navigate this tension will define whether power users stay or flee to open-source alternatives.

model_literacy.relevance: Sonnet 5 touts a 1M-token native context window, but native length and the amount of context a model can reliably attend to are two different numbers. Understanding this gap is how you evaluate any model's long-context claims without getting burned.

items.title: Anthropic's Sonnet 5 Goes All-In on Agentic Coding With 1M Native Context
items.angle: The most capable Sonnet yet ships with native 1M-token context and aggressive promo pricing — Anthropic is betting that agent-grade reasoning at Sonnet-tier cost wins the developer market.
items.key_fact: $2/$10 per Mtok promotional pricing through August 31

items.title: Claude Science Launches as Anthropic's First Vertical Product
items.angle: A dedicated AI workbench for scientists isn't just a feature — it's Anthropic signaling that the highest-leverage Claude applications live in domain-specific tools, not general chat.
items.key_fact: 335 likes and 112 RTs in first hours — scientists are paying attention

items.title: Google Fires Two Shots: Nano Banana 2 Lite for Edge, Omni Flash for Multimodal
items.angle: DeepMind is splitting its model strategy into edge-optimized and multimodal-cheap tiers, directly challenging both Apple's on-device play and the API pricing war.
items.key_fact: Two models targeting opposite ends of the cost-capability spectrum

items.title: Mistral Drops Leanstral 1.5 as the Efficient-Model Race Gets Crowded
items.angle: Another entrant in the small-model tier — the real story is how fast this market segment is filling up.
items.key_fact: Third lean model launch this week alongside Nano Banana and Apple's on-device push

items.title: MCP TypeScript SDK v2 Beta Lands With Breaking Changes and a Deadline
items.angle: The MCP team is asking developers to break things now so the July 28 stable release doesn't break them later — upgrade your integrations before it ships.
items.key_fact: Split wire-layer codecs and per-era protocol handling — this isn't a minor bump

items.title: Claude Code v2.1.197 Makes Sonnet 5 the Default
items.angle: If you're using Claude Code, you're now on Sonnet 5 by default — update to get the 1M-token context window without config changes.
items.key_fact: Sonnet 5 is now the out-of-the-box model for all Claude Code users

items.title: Anthropic's Python SDK Expands the Managed Agents API Surface
items.angle: Back-to-back releases add event delta streaming, vault credential injection, and webhook events — the agent-builder API is growing fast.
items.key_fact: v0.114.0–v0.115.0 shipped same-day with full Managed Agents feature parity

items.title: HuggingFace Puts Every Eval Result on Every Model Page
items.angle: No more hunting through scattered leaderboards — community eval results are now integrated directly into model pages.
items.key_fact: Community-contributed evals surfaced alongside official benchmarks on model cards

items.title: Ollama v0.31 Brings Tighter Gemma 4 MoE and an MLX Matmul Kernel
items.angle: The version jump from 0.30.x signals meaningful internal changes — local inference tooling keeps shipping weekly.
items.key_fact: New small-batch matmul kernel from MLX and llama.cpp bumped to b9840

items.title: Anthropic's Official Guide to Agentic Loops in Claude Code
items.angle: The run-evaluate-rerun pattern is becoming the default for agentic coding — this walkthrough shows you how to actually use it.
items.key_fact: Official guide covering iterative loop patterns for Claude Code workflows

items.title: Simon Willison: Have Your Agent Record Video Demos of Its Work
items.angle: Using shot-scraper to auto-record agent work sessions is a clever trust-building pattern — show stakeholders what your agent actually did, not just what it says it did.
items.key_fact: shot-scraper video captures full browser sessions driven by AI agents

items.title: IBM's ScarfBench Finally Benchmarks What Developers Actually Do: Migrate Java
items.angle: Most AI coding benchmarks test greenfield generation — this one tests the painful real-world task of framework migration on enterprise Java codebases.
items.key_fact: Purpose-built benchmark for evaluating AI agents on enterprise Java framework migrations

items.title: Meta's Brain2Qwerty Translates Brain Waves to Text Without Surgery
items.angle: Non-invasive BCI that actually produces readable text from EEG — a step toward communication for people who can't speak or type.
items.key_fact: EEG-to-text without surgical implants, from Meta AI Research

items.title: Researcher Catches Claude Code Embedding Steganographic Markers in API Requests
items.angle: 1,300+ upvotes on an exposé about hidden telemetry in the most popular AI coding tool — the developer trust implications go far beyond one product.
items.key_fact: 1,319 likes on the blog post revealing invisible markers in Claude Code's API calls

items.title: The Case That General-Purpose Models Will Give Way to Specialists
items.angle: Dharma AI's specialization thesis directly contradicts the one-model-fits-all trend — and Claude Science's launch the same day is Exhibit A.
items.key_fact: Published on HuggingFace, argues domain-specialized models will outcompete generalists

items.title: After Two AIEWF Workshops, the Verdict: Local AI Is Closing the Gap
items.angle: Ahmad Osman's argument lands as Ollama, llama.cpp, and MLX ship improvements weekly — the local-vs-cloud gap is narrowing faster than most assume.
items.key_fact: Post-workshop analysis from two AIEWF sessions on local AI adoption

items.title: Fundamental-Ava: Open-Source Framework for Socially Intelligent Digital Humans
items.angle: 592 stars for an autonomous digital human framework — the intersection of embodied AI and multi-agent collaboration is attracting serious builder interest.
items.key_fact: 592 GitHub stars, targeting autonomous agents with social intelligence
